infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RentPE requires camera access to capture room photos and 360° virtual room tours.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: RentPE uses orientation sensors to guide you when capturing full-sphere ceiling, eye-level, and floor photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RentPE uses your location to show rooms near you and auto-select your city.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow RentPE to use your camera to take room photos and 360° tours.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow RentPE to use your location to find rooms near you.
